visualCharacteristics.purpose: featured article teaser with a large image beside a tinted text panel
visualCharacteristics.description: Fixed-width two-column layout: large image left (~60%), light-grey (#ebebeb) text panel right with eyebrow 'Featured Article', h2, paragraph, yellow CTA. Grey belongs to the block's text cell, section itself is white.

cells: eyebrow paragraph, h2, description, CTA link
contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 image; cell 2 eyebrow paragraph, heading, description, CTA link

usage: Single featured-content teaser (article, story) shown side by side with its image.
reuseGuidance: Use when one item is promoted with image left and text panel right. For grids of items use cards-article.
